role: set of free variables of a formula
notes: Finite set of variables; used for the free-variable condition on eliminations.

role: theory of successor with a named initial element
notes: Signature {0,S}; axioms listed in the defining entry; axiomatizes Th(N;0,S).

role: k-fold application of the successor symbol
notes: S^0 t is t; abbreviation of a term, not a new symbol.

precedence: complement binds tighter than meet, meet tighter than join
notes: Object-language symbols of the Boolean-algebra signature, kept distinct from the connectives; \(\sqcup\) also registered as a blank tape symbol in P4 (different scope).
Abbreviation (u meet -v) join (-u meet v); same meaning as the P15 symmetric-difference rows, distinct from P6 diagonal intersection.
BA with 0 distinct from 1 plus the atomless axiom.
Unary relation symbol for each integer n at least 1; true of m iff n divides m.

role: additive signatures with congruence predicates and their standard structures
notes: L_N omits unary minus; N is a substructure of the L_N-reduct of Z.

role: relativization of quantifiers to the nonnegative integers
notes: Used in the annex proof of the congruence elimination.

role: theory of algebraically closed fields with no characteristic axiom
notes: Field axioms plus the root axioms; contained in every ACF_p of sec:p03-w03-p03-020-fields; decidable and incomplete.

role: recursive elimination procedure for a system of parametric equations and one inequation
notes: Returns a quantifier-free formula in the parameters; F_i equations, G the product of the inequations.
